dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Five prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit thin, high-contrast light-gray perimeters against a dark charcoal background. The geometry is irregular and crenulated, with sharp transitions between the dark exterior and the thin light boundary; interiors of the loops are dark, matching the exterior coat intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density. A single, distinct high-intensity white pixel cluster is visible near the tail section on the ventral edge. Other regions lack concentrated solid blobs with high core pixel intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an irregular triangle with an obtuse angle at the most dorsal vertex. A fourth centroid from a smaller ventral annulus creates an elongated diamond configuration when connected to the primary triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: The macro-annuli are arranged in a dense, interlocking tessellation pattern covering the mid-section, where individual rings share boundary segments.
